accepted_plan.summary: Accept minimal WASM Plugin Tool runtime. Implement no-ambient-authority module execution for enabled Plugin Tools with bounded input/output/errors, timeout/cancellation, deterministic module selection, and focused tests.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates dedicated implementation worktree and spawns Coder with write scope limited to that worktree. Reviewer will run read-only after implementation report. Can run in parallel with Panel E2E readiness fix because source surfaces are distinct.
